title: Etale local model uv=h of an at-worst-nodal family of relative dimension one
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes which is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], such that for every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ and every geometric point $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ [def-weil-geometric-point] the geometric fibre $X_\Omega=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [def-weil-geometric-fibre] is either empty or equidimensional of dimension $1$ [def-kun-dimension], and each point of $X_\Omega$ at which $X_\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ is not smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] has completed local ring isomorphic to $\Omega[[u,v]]/(uv)$. Let $x\in X$ be a point at which $f$ is not smooth, i.e. a singular point of its fibre $X_s$, $s=f(x)$. Then there exist an etale morphism $V\to S$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], a global function $h\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$, an etale morphism $U\to X$, a morphism $U\to V$ whose composite with $V\to S$ equals the composite $U\to X\to S$, and an etale $V$-morphism $U\to W$, where $W=V\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[a]}\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[u,v,a]/(uv-a)=\operatorname{Spec}_V\mathcal O_V[u,v]/(uv-h)$ is the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] along the morphism $V\to\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z[a]$ given by $a\mapsto h$, together with a point of $U$ mapping to $x$.
